scope: Compact extraction of four retained CPU reports. Includes every protocol, gate, final measurement and recorded-frame measurement. Does not include full source text, particle snapshots or all per-step diagnostics.
auditBoundary: Original byte hashes, checksum sidecars and embedded source hashes were verified during extraction. Numerical gates are reported values, not an independent recomputation of physics.
rawReportAvailability: Original relative paths name ignored local results files; they are not included in this summary. The corresponding CPU scripts can generate fresh complete records.
selectionPolicy: Includes the first beam screen, first local-cut follow-up, first casting attempt and first explicitly revised casting-v2 attempt. No failed attempt in these four screens was omitted.

protocol.qualityGate: Both lanes finish finite; solid final load COM y>=8.0 and >=2.0 above liquid control, solid load speed<=2.5, max relative mass error<1e-10.
protocol.scope: A constrained elastic beam with real particle load; no mesh import, fracture, calibrated ice, or arbitrary crafted bridge claim. Shared-grid numerical contact, no hidden bridge collider.

protocol.interpretation: Follow-up extends time and makes an explicit local material intervention. The first two-second settling failure remains unchanged. No settling gate, no calibrated fracture or melting claim.

protocol.scope: One two-bar candidate, no settings search. All body particles start liquid; load starts held by an explicit collider. At4s both branches remove grille, mold and load holder; one changes body to solid, the other stays liquid. Named banks and end clamps remain. No repositioning or later particle spawn.

One v2 engineering candidate. A raised mold, relocated bars, additional liquid volume and stiffer elastic material correct the diagnosed v1 support mismatch. No parameter sweep or force controller. Support and central occupancy gates are necessary checks, not a continuum connectivity proof.
